user_request: Fine-tune VideoMamba and ST-GCN with human labels, predicted other and all previous ROI source groups. No XCLIP.
conflict_policy: User approved excluding every intersecting window; original JSON preserved
excluded_policy: Excluded entity: entire track across generations. Uncertain intervals: +/-1 second. Conflicts: every overlapping input window.
weak_policy: Only baseline other with RGB-other >=.9, detector>=.5, same identity confirmed human, outside all reviewed intervals +/-1s. At least2s gap, <=8/identity, <=200/source. Loss weight.25. Never evaluation truth.
old_policy: Keep frozen old source splits. Prefer current frontend at same-person exact source-frame windows (>=26/32 boxes IoU>=.8); preserve legacy-only windows and all sources. Report canonical and legacy separately.

training.sampling: Per class 70% old / 30% new when both exist; equal source mass, per-window inverse count. Weak labels loss*.25. Old replay + old-teacher KL.
training.checkpoint_selection: Validation only: old positive macro recall >= epoch0-.05 and new positive macro recall >=epoch0-.10; minimize equal-domain human-other FPR, then maximize supported macro F1. If infeasible retain epoch0. Individual branches at action .75; final full scheme grid separately.

tuning.objective: Validation only, no pseudo truth. Preserve old supported-class positive recall within 5pp and new positives within10pp of production baseline; minimize equal-domain other FPR, then macro F1, then positive TP.
tuning.geometry: Fixed matched ROI/action windows; frame-level luma masks applied to skeleton and priors. Full frontend replay of selected configuration required before deployment claim.

historical_test_limit: Old initializers/history saw sources; all new9 already influenced earlier calibration. Group-isolated this round, not a new blind generalization set.
